assumption_to_test: A three-entity execution reconciliation, recovery verification, and policy promotion chain is sufficient to reproduce state transitions without controlling deployment.
smallest_testable_validation: Extend qif-ledger schema, example, verifier, and negative fixtures with one failed activation reconciliation, one verified rollback recovery, and one promotion-blocked outcome derived from v0.8.7 records.
expected_learning: Whether declared-versus-observed state, recovery completion, and promotion eligibility can be reproduced deterministically while remaining provider-neutral and non-authoritative.
expected_cost: One bounded schema, verifier, documentation, portable package, and release slice.
success_threshold: Positive example passes; retained negative fixtures reject absent execution evidence, state mismatch, incomplete recovery, unresolved governance, missing authority, history mutation, and invalid promotion.
